LanguageData.USAC_Gun_BushmasterAC.label: Bushmaster autocannon
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_BushmasterAC.description: An M901 "Bushmaster III" large-caliber chain cannon, built to be mounted on armored vehicles and aircraft. It fires depleted uranium autocannon rounds that tear through infantry and light armor alike.
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_BushmasterAC.tools.stock.label: stock

LanguageData.USAC_Gun_CobraAC.label: Cobra assault cannon
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_CobraAC.description: A large-scale assault rifle designed to provide suppressive fire. Standard armament for medium automatroids, it can also be wielded by large augmented humans or soldiers wearing heavy exoskeletons. The weapon's high rate of fire makes it effective for sustained suppression against infantry targets.
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_CobraAC.tools.stock.label: stock
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_CobraAC.tools.barrel.label: barrel
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_TorchwoodRR.label: Torchwood recoilless rifle
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_TorchwoodRR.description: The M40A3 "Torchwood", a heavy recoilless rifle with an automatic loading system. Recoilless operation keeps it light for its caliber, and its explosive fragmentation shell makes it a superb anti-fortification weapon - devastating against massed infantry and structures alike.
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_TorchwoodRR.tools.stock.label: stock
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_TorchwoodRR.tools.barrel.label: barrel
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_ViperDMR.label: Viper DMR
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_ViperDMR.description: An M905 "Viper" large-caliber precision anti-materiel weapon system using autocannon ammunition. Designed to be mounted on medium automatroids, it can also be wielded by large augmented humans or soldiers wearing heavy exoskeletons. Excels at long-range precision strikes against armored targets.
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_ViperDMR.tools.stock.label: stock
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_ViperDMR.tools.barrel.label: barrel
